ov: The smallest fox, from the deserts of North Africa. Its huge ears, the biggest for its size of any member of the dog family, shed heat and pick up prey moving underground.

why.p: Bred commercially as an exotic pet, and kept as one as far back as ancient Rome.
why.ac: A night hunter that shelters by day from the desert heat.

rg: The Sahara, from Western Sahara and Mauritania to the Sinai Peninsula.
df: Mainly insects, small mammals and birds.

cf.tip: The fennec is far smaller than a red fox, with much bigger ears.

fx: Fennec family burrows can cover 120 m² and join up with the burrows of other families.
